items.stem: A marketer imported a purchased email list and asks why sending to it is risky. What is the core problem?

options.text: The contacts never gave consent, so emailing them can breach consent rules and harm deliverability and trust
options.rationale: Correct: emailing non-consenting contacts raises legal and deliverability problems and damages sender reputation.

options.text: Purchased lists are always technically impossible to import
options.rationale: They can be imported; the problem is consent and quality, not capability.

options.text: The CRM cannot store more than a few contacts
options.rationale: Contact capacity is not the issue here.
Imported contacts can be segmented; consent is the real concern.

items.explanation: Correct: emailing non-consenting contacts raises legal and deliverability problems and damages sender reputation.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO signals better indicate a campaign's business impact than email opens alone? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Contacts that progressed to a later lifecycle stage
options.rationale: Correct: lifecycle progression reflects real movement toward revenue.

options.text: Deals created or influenced by the campaign
options.rationale: Correct: created or influenced deals tie the campaign to pipeline.
Subject-line length is an input, not an outcome.

options.text: The colour of the call-to-action button
options.rationale: Button colour is a design detail, not a business outcome.

items.explanation: Correct: lifecycle progression reflects real movement toward revenue.

items.stem: New contacts from a webinar should receive a two-email welcome over three days, with a different path if they book a demo. What should the marketer build?

options.text: A workflow with a delay and a branch based on the demo-booking condition
options.rationale: Correct: a workflow automates timed, conditional follow-up based on contact behaviour.

options.text: A single bulk email sent manually each day
options.rationale: Manual sends are not conditional and do not scale or branch.

options.text: A static list with no actions
options.rationale: A list segments contacts but performs no follow-up.
A landing page captures contacts; it does not sequence follow-up.

items.explanation: Correct: a workflow automates timed, conditional follow-up based on contact behaviour.
